questions.question:
Select the correct alternative to indicate the arrangement of the following phrases in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Vacant post in organization

2. Receiving Applications

3. Conducting written test and interviews

4. Inviting applications for post

5. Job offer to selected candidates

6. Joining and on-the-job training
questions.solution:
The steps in the process of employing a candidate are as follows:

1) Vacant post in organization

4) Inviting applications for post

2) Receiving Applications

3) Conducting written test and interviews

5) Job offer to selected candidates

6) Joining and on-the-job training

Hence, “1, 4, 2, 3, 5, 6” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the gaps of the given letter series will complete the series.

T C _ M B C _ N T _ Q M _ C D _ T _ Q M B _ D N
questions.solution:
The pattern is as follows:

1) QDDBCCN → T C **__Q __**M B C **__D__** N / T **__D__** Q M **__B__** C D **__C__** / T **__C__** Q M B **__N__** D N → Does not follow any pattern

2) QDCBNCC → T C **__Q __**M B C **__D__** N / T **__C__** Q M **__B__** C D **__N__** / T **__C__** Q M B **__C__** D N → Follows a pattern i.e., TCQMBCDN is repeated.

3) TDCBNCD → T C **__T __**M B C **__D__** N / T **__C__** Q M **__B__** C D **__N__** / T **__C__** Q M B **__D__** D N → Does not follow any pattern

4) QBCDNNC → T C **__Q __**M B C **__B__** N / T **__C__** Q M **__D__** C D **__N__** / T **__N__** Q M B **__C__** D N → Does not follow any pattern

Hence, “QDCBNCC” is the correct answer

questions.question: Three persons A, B and C have different amount of rupees with them. If A gives 11 to C, A will have equal amount as B has. A and B together have total 245. How many rupees does B have?
questions.solution:
Let the total amount with B be Rs. X.

After giving to C, remaining amount with A = Total amount of A – 11 = X

Total amount of A = X + 11

Given, Total amount of A + Total amount of B = 245

It means, X + 11 + X = 245

2X = 245 – 11 = 234

X = 117

Total amount that B has is Rs. 117

Hence, “117” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some ants are bats.

Some ants are crabs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some bats are crabs.

II. No crab is ant.

III. No bat is crab.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Either conclusion I or III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c467ed444f7b1a8f00d1f753baa0abeac71541feaf48eeb0f274f5ea6afa289.png] 

I. Some bats are crabs → False (it is possible but not definite).

II. No crab is ant → False (some ants are crabs)

III. No bat is crab → False (it is possible but not definite).

Here, I and III form a complementary pair.

Hence, “either conclusion I or III follows” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A + B means ‘A is sister of B’

A – B means ‘A is son of B’

A × B means ‘A is husband of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is mother of B’

If P + Q ÷ C – D – L × J, then how is J related to Q?
questions.solution:
We will use the below table of symbols to create a family tree.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bfdb316962e668cc9d97d55b3c4ac66051d333249fd0c699c26b4628f61a49a.png] 

The codes are as follows:

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 

 
 
Of B

 
 
 

 

**Given statement:** P + Q ÷ C – D – L × J means P is the sister of Q who is the mother of C. C is the son of D who is the son of L. L is the husband of J.

The family tree is as follows:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fe1b1e6e7a2f586b1470a437b60d00544cb4cdaeaa9d834229b82ad83f4c3b3.png] 

In the above diagram, we can see that J is the mother of D whose wife is Q. So, J is the mother in law of Q.

Hence, “mother in law” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

**8, 9, 145**
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

8, 9, 145 → 8² + 9² = 64 + 81 = 145

Similarly,

6, 7, 85 → 6² + 7² = 36 + 49 = 85

Hence, “6, 7, 85” is the correct answer.

Three different positions of the same dice, which has one to six dots on its six faces, are shown below. When one dot is at the bottom the number of dots on the top will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee1aeb3d9d093e3979d04e8a879986662e1274623bb44e8a0024397a09c1810f.png]
questions.solution:
Adjacent dots to 2 = 1, 6, 4, 3. Therefore, dot 2 is opposite to dot 5.

Adjacent dots to 6 = 1, 2, 3, 5. Therefore, dot 6 is opposite to dot 4.

Therefore, the remaining faces i.e. 1 and 3 will be opposite to each other.

Hence, when one dot is at the bottom the number of dots on the top will be 3.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(94, 44, 82)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number + 3rd number) ÷ 4 = 2nd number**.

Here, (94, 44, 82)

⇒ (94 + 82) ÷ 4

⇒ 176 ÷ 4 = 44.

Similarly, for **(48, 31, 76)**

**⇒ (48 + 76) ÷ 4**

**⇒ 124 ÷ 4 = 31**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
